Licenças dos shaders em art/third_party/shaders/ (conferido em 2026-09-24)

godotshaders.com: cada post declara a licença do código ('The shader code and all code snippets in this post are under CC0 license / MIT license and can be used freely'). A declaração aparece no rodapé de cada post (URL listada abaixo).

- shockwave_zawarudo.gdshader — IceTeea — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/za-warudo-shockwave-effect/
- shockwave_ring_simple.gdshader — snesmocha — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/impact-shader/
- speedlines_anime.gdshader — ProfesorShader — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/anime-style-speedlines-w-or-w-o-distortion/
- chromatic_aberration_radial.gdshader — alfroids — MIT — https://godotshaders.com/shader/radial-chromatic-aberration-2/
- impact_frame_manga.gdshader — hailyn — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/screen-sampled-black-and-white-manga-hit-impact-post-process-shader/
- impact_frame_threshold.gdshader — TTien63 — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/threshold-silohoutte-effect/
- dissolve_burn_edge.gdshader — mreliptik — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/2d-dissolve-with-burn-edge/
- heat_haze_shimmer.gdshader — Gerardo LCDF — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/yoshis-island-shimmer-heat-haze-distortion/
- lightning_arc.gdshader — lumenfruit — MIT — https://godotshaders.com/shader/2d-lightning-electric-arc-plasma/
- outline_inline_2d.gdshader — Juulpower — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/2d-outline-inline/
- hit_flash.gdshader — triangledevv — MIT — https://godotshaders.com/shader/hit-flash-effect-shader/
- screen_glass_shatter.gdshader — miwls — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/simple-glass-broken/
- bloom_screen.gdshader — VEGAMETA — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/bloom/
- glow_screen_cheap.gdshader — GDQuest — MIT — https://github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-4-VFX-assets/blob/main/to_sort/shaders/glow.gdshader
- shield_bubble_2d.gdshader — Pan — CC0-1.0 — https://godotshaders.com/shader/hexagon-shield/
- afterimage_ghost.gdshader — Opus 5.5 (original deste projeto) — CC0-1.0 — (original)
- smoke_puff_toon.gdshader — Opus 5.5 (original deste projeto) — CC0-1.0 — (original)
